role: PRIMARY new experiment (owner approval 2026-10-23); the strict T-60 study remains the conservative control
notes: Preregistered, ADDITIVE, read-only study that runs BESIDE the unchanged strict T-60 control (ISSUE53_EXEC_SHADOW_V1, exec_shadow_config_v2.json, pinned below by sha256). It changes exactly ONE thing: the board-selection rule. The control requires the latest tick OBSERVED by the checkpoint to have been COMMITTED by it; this study takes the latest tick that was observed AND committed by the checkpoint. Because the capture branch receives ticks a median 211 s (max 502 s) after they are observed, the control loses a game whenever its latest tick is that young (latency_diag: 5 of 14 games usable at T-60); on any game the control can evaluate, this study picks the SAME board (a tick committed by the checkpoint that is also the latest observed one) - the two studies differ only on the games the control loses. The decision instant (T-60), every selection rule and threshold, the 900 s quote-age guard, quality gates, costs, exposure caps, settlement and the sealing window are identical to the control. Prospective evidence exists only as SEALED pre-tip ledger entries on the separate branch exec-shadow-seals-t60a; its evidence counts and verdicts are never pooled with the control's. Changing any value means a new version and a new later start.

control.note: unchanged; keeps its own ledger branch, start date and evidence counts

base_protocol.note: quality gates (two-sided, active, top size, spread <= 0.15, price 0.03-0.97, no BLOCK gate), the fee multiplier and the thesis definitions are read from the pinned base file, not re-declared. A test fails if the base file's digest changes.

checkpoint.max_quote_age_note: age of the board at the checkpoint (checkpoint - board_observed_utc); 900 s is the existing CLOSING_MAX_AGE_S constant of the paper system, chosen before any result was scored here and not tuned. The base 1800 s board-age gate also still applies.
checkpoint.board_after_checkpoint: NO_TRADE (a board observed after the checkpoint is never used)
checkpoint.missing_or_stale_board: NO_TRADE for the whole game (reason recorded per game); never replaced by another horizon, never backfilled
checkpoint.board_rule: the board of a game is the latest capture tick that was OBSERVED at or before the T-60 checkpoint AND COMMITTED to the capture branch (git commit time of the commit that added its file) at or before it. This is the ONLY change relative to the strict T-60 study, whose rule is 'the latest tick OBSERVED at or before the checkpoint, which must itself be committed by it, else NO_TRADE'. Nothing committed after the checkpoint is ever read; no grace window, no later horizon, no fallback beyond the 1800 s gap; a board older than max_quote_age_s (900 s, unchanged) makes every candidate STALE_QUOTE_AT_CHECKPOINT.
checkpoint.forecast_rule: player and game forecasts must be generated, self-archived AND committed to projection-data at or before the checkpoint; the engine's as-of rule (generated <= board time) is unchanged

execution.fee_rounding: whole-order, round-up-to-cent taker fee (nba_edge.kalshi.fees) used BOTH for the entry decision (ev_net_exec) and for settlement
execution.dnp_policy: participation-aware: p_model prices the DNP leg at the decision-time mid; settlement values a DNP at the authoritative Kalshi scalar when archived, otherwise the LAST_VALID mid (flagged modeled_last_valid_mid); never a fee-free void
execution.insufficient_displayed_depth: the candidate is blocked (INSUFFICIENT_DEPTH) -> PASS / NO_TRADE; no partial fill is imagined and nothing is filled beyond the displayed top-of-book size

PF_EDGE_STRICT_T60_AVAIL_V1.rule: one fixed pretip checkpoint (T-60) per game; board = latest tick observed AND committed by it; PASS-only; one highest-net-EV contract per thesis; global chronological exposure ledger (this study's own)

exposure.scope: ONE global chronological ledger across all checkpoints and games (caps are never reset between horizon snapshots or runs); positions are admitted in decision-instant order, within an instant by descending ev_net_exec; a thesis already held can never be entered again

evidence.value_validation_requires: n_decisions >= 200 AND n_games >= 40 AND lower 95% bound of ROI > 0 under BOTH game-clustered and player-game-clustered bootstraps
evidence.language: never 'edge', 'profitable' or 'validated' below the minimums; first-week results are descriptive only
evidence.own_counts: this study's decisions and games are counted on its own ledger only; reported next to the control's and never pooled

no_tuning: No threshold above was chosen or changed after looking at 2026-10-20 / 2026-10-21 results. Any optimisation is a distinct FUTURE experiment with its own preregistration, prospective start and multiple-testing discipline.

sealing.earliest_note: measured tick-to-commit lag on the capture branch: median 213 s, p90 357 s, max 502 s (150 real ticks 2026-10-20..22); 600 s covers the maximum observed with margin
sealing.deadline_note: a seal must be committed to the ledger branch at least 10 minutes before tip; later = LATE (uncounted)
sealing.missed_marker: a game with no seal after its window is recorded as MISSED (uncounted, alert); never sealed late as if on time
counted_iff: seal verifies (sha256 of body and of the candidate file)
protocol_sha256 equals this file's sha256 and study_version equals its version
computed_utc >= prospective_start_utc, checkpoint_utc >= prospective_start_utc, computed inside [checkpoint + earliest_after_checkpoint_s, tip - deadline_before_tip_s]
the seal and its candidate file are each ADDED exactly once on the ledger branch, never modified/deleted/renamed afterwards, and byte-identical to the adding commit
the adding commit's SERVER commit time is >= computed_utc - 120 s and <= tip - deadline_before_tip_s
it is the first (earliest-added) seal of its game; later duplicates are DUPLICATE_UNCOUNTED
run from the default branch by schedule/workflow_dispatch; code sha reachable from the default branch; protocol file committed on the default branch before prospective_start_utc
independent clocks recorded in the seal
the sealed board was committed at or before the checkpoint and is the latest tick observed AND committed at/before it in the FINAL archive; the tip in the seal equals the final schedule's tip
never: recompute a sealed selection from later archive state
count a seal produced by a branch/PR workflow run
overwrite, edit or delete a seal
pool this ledger with the control's
sealing.cadence: the SAME sealing chain as the control (one extra lane; no additional scheduler)
sealing.commit_clock: the seal commit is created through the GitHub Git Data API (no client-supplied dates): its commit time is the SERVER clock at creation, independent of the runner clock; a failed or late publish simply leaves no seal

executability.price_drift_diagnostic: for every selected contract the sealed ask is compared with the ask on the first board observed after the checkpoint (descriptive 'drift', never used in a selection)
executability.quote_freshness: board age at the checkpoint (checkpoint - tick observed) is recorded on every seal and reported per study
executability.note: archived quotes are displayed top-of-book quotes, not proven live fills; every output says so

projection_accuracy.rule: forecast accuracy (pf_core.prospective scorecard) is evaluated on ALL eligible games with settled forecasts, independent of any trade decision, market, seal or lane
